Phrase 8 (3:21.6) introduces Ab, centred on Ab. Phrase 10 (3:55.9) introduces C, centred on Bb. The line peaks at Dk5 (585.8 Hz) at 4:41.9. It closes on the tonic (Dk3 → Dk3 → Dk4 → Ak4 → Ak4 → Ak4).
